message.content: {"caption":"A repeated decision cycle links each state, retrieved case, action, and reward to an evolving case memory.","description":"A left-to-right graphical model with three visible time points, 0, 1, and t, separated by ellipses for omitted intermediate steps. Each time point has a state node sᵢ above a row of case cᵢ, action aᵢ, and reward rᵢ nodes; a memory node Mᵢ sits below. The labels denote the state, retrieved case, action, reward, and case memory, respectively. Red arrows are labelled in the legend “Environment Dynamics”: each state points right to the next state, and each action also points diagonally to that next state; both the state and action point to the reward at the same time point. Blue arrows are labelled “Agent Behaviour”: each state points down to its case and diagonally to its action; the case points right to the action; and each memory points up to its case. Memory advances from M₀ to M₁ and onward, with blue arrows from the current state, action, and reward also feeding into the next memory. The same connections are shown for the displayed time points, with ellipses indicating continuation. The arrows have no individual text labels beyond the two legend labels.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
